title: The QCLI-148 guide-command checker resolves a full `quest task list --across-refs` mention against the `task list` help, not the --across-refs entry's flags
description: Found while writing QCLI-432's guide text. test/contract/guide-commands.test.ts resolves an inline `quest ...` mention to the longest command manifest name, so `quest task list --across-refs` resolves to `task list` and its flags are checked against commandHelp["task list"].flags -- which does not carry --across-refs (that flag is documented under its own help entry, "task list --across-refs"). A guide that names the full command therefore fails a check whose intent it satisfies. The guides currently work around it by omitting the `quest ` prefix (guides.ts line 46), which the checker does not examine. Either teach the checker to resolve subcommand help entries, or record the limitation. Filed by the quest-cli worker after landing QCLI-432, at team-lead instruction; UNSTAMPED.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A guide line naming the full `quest task list --across-refs` command passes the QCLI-148 checker, or the checker's limited resolution is documented where a future guide author will read it
